profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer | EnergyTech | Full-stack + Data Engineering | Zero→One (3x)
profile.summary: Software engineering leader in EnergyTech. I ship zero-to-one systems (3 launches) across full-stack + data engineering, turning complex data and operations into reliable products. Work spans ETL, timeseries, micro-frontends, mono-repos, and ledger-backed inventory management, built for auditability and scale.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
1AP is building the next generation power plant technology: turn-key, optimized power systems delivering clean, Hyperfirm, high capacity power for demanding customer loads in a rapidly electrifying world.

- Founding engineer - setup AWS infrastructure, ACL, mesh & site-to-site VPNs, networking, etc.
- Designed & implemented time-series IoT data pipeline leveraging MQTT, S3, Postgres, Grafana, Lambda, SQS, Kinesis, Flink, InfluxDB etc.
- Designed & created applications spanning EMS, SCADA, Power Plant Controls, Data Historians, and O&M applications.

- Product manager & Software Engineer to build performance optimization, internal techno-economic analysis for mixed-generation power plants.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Edge Computing · Early-Stage Startups · On Premises Data Gateway · Data Engineering · Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Pants · Amazon Kinesis · Apache Flink · Mqtt · Firehose · InfluxDB · Techno-economic Analysis · pySAM

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
LevelTen Energy provides transaction infrastructure in the renewable energy economy. 
- Launched a new energy certificate settlement product built on top of an immutable ledger database. 
- Built data pipelines generating forward and historical cashflow analytics from time-series generation data, forecasted prices, and weather data.
- Developed scalable ingestion and analytics processes using indexed Parquet files for efficient data retrieval across energy assets.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Financial Accounting · Startups · Polars · Python (Programming Language) · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Angular · Data Engineering · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
R1RCM is a large player in the Revenue Cycle Management game for healthcare. I lead a scrum team that's passionate about revolutionizing the way a patient & their healthcare provider interact.

- Led and directed a high-performing Scrum team to successfully deliver a new product to a pilot client.

- Successfully scaled new product beyond pilot client handling a significant increase in appointments, clinic network expansion, and user base growth within a single quarter.

- Successfully integrated analytics framework, revealing 1 in 10 client clinics were misusing the product, fostering collaboration with Product and Support for enhanced insights and targeted training, improving technology utilization.

- Leveraged analytics framework to promptly address scalability issue, significantly reducing peak- time timeout rates by across applications, improving performance and user experience.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Startups · TypeScript · Node.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Appriver offers cloud-based cybersecurity solutions. 

- Member of the scrum team that manages our business systems including new features, bug fixes, and tech debt. [ASP.net/Core/Angular/Mongo/SQL/Event Sourcing/CQRS]

- Integrated products and systems during company acquisition. 

- Assisted with the designing, planning, and implementing of the decomposition of two monolithic web applications into Azure hosted micro services (also a shift away from event sourcing architecture into our own custom solution).

- Project Lead for extracting Sales services out of a monolithic application and implementing them in a standalone API. [ASP.net/Core]
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · SQL · TypeScript · Node.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Educators Resource is a wholesale distributor of teacher supplies. 

- Reduced company costs by an estimated 25k-30k annually by implementing a 3rd party middleware for address validation in a legacy OMS environment. [C/C++]
- Identified bottlenecks in the Data Management department and created a web application to streamline department work. [ASP.net/SQL/Azure]
- Shared duties amongst IT department to keep the lights on. [SQL/Access]

positions.title: Research Assistant / Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Developer on UWF's Smart Home Project aimed to assist the elderly in independent living.
- Utilized Java tools in client-server environments including Java Platform, Enterprise Edition (Java EE), Enterprise Java Bean (EJB), and Java database Connectivity (JDBC) technologies.
- Utilize phpMyAdmin for managing multiple MySQL Databases for examining the trade-offs between security, scalability, and efficiency of sensor networks in IoT environments. 
- Experience with deploying and testing on Oracle’s Glassfish Server.
- Implemented secured web services for data storage and retrieval.

company.name: University of West Florida Computer Science Department

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
- Implemented problem solving techniques to resolve technical issues with cable, internet, and telephony equipment.
- Managed a high-volume workload within a deadline-driven environment.

positions.title: Supervisor
positions.description:
- Interface with over 100 customers a day to ensure customer satisfaction. 
- Adhere to a strict schedule, to ensure floor staff team completes daily duties within a time-sensitive environment. 
- Improved inventory stocking efficiency by streamlining daily and weekly tasks. 
- Improved hourly employee schedules by developing a system to efficiently trade, take, and give away shifts.
